events.event: Green SM Bike, the Vietnamese VinFast-backed electric ride-hailing service launched in Jakarta in September 2026, officially stopped operating in Indonesia on 20 November, per CNBC Indonesia.
events.key_numbers: Service stopped 20 Nov 2026 · launched Sept 2026 with 75% launch discounts (Katadata) · driver fallout not verified
events.why_it_matters: A new ojol rival shut down within about two months, leaving drivers and users to switch.
events.spreading_evidence: Two CNBC Indonesia tech headlines on 20 Nov

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported about 4,000 retired civil servants were hit by hacking and that their pension funds are at risk.
events.key_numbers: ~4,000 retired civil servants affected (headline figure) · amounts not verified
events.why_it_matters: Pensioners' monthly income may be exposed to account takeover.

events.event: Credit card data of Visa and Mastercard holders was reported leaked and circulated online, per CNBC Indonesia.
events.key_numbers: Visa and Mastercard card data leaked online · volume and Indonesian exposure not verified
events.why_it_matters: Cardholders may need to watch statements and replace cards.

events.event: Komdigi summoned Google to discuss the closure of 19,389 YouTube accounts linked to Indonesia, after Google removed channels tied to pro-government influence operations.
events.key_numbers: 19,389 YouTube accounts closed (CNBC Indonesia) · Komdigi summons Google 20 Nov · Google earlier cited 10,134 channels for one batch (Bisnis, 18 Nov)
events.why_it_matters: The state is questioning a platform over takedowns of channels linked to government-friendly buzzers.
events.spreading_evidence: Top of CNBC Indonesia tech 20 Nov

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported that people are reluctant to buy new phones in 2026 and phone sellers are struggling to sell.
events.key_numbers: Qualitative report; sales figures not verified · earlier CNBC (19 Oct) said rising smartphone prices cut demand
events.why_it_matters: Phone prices are rising because of the memory chip squeeze, so buyers are holding on to old phones.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported that old phones will be blocked from WhatsApp if owners ignore warnings about unsupported OS versions.
events.why_it_matters: Users of old phones may lose WhatsApp access.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia reported that Google will make major changes in January 2027 that could suddenly block some phone apps.
events.why_it_matters: Android users may see apps stop working.

events.event: Facebook launched a new standalone app called Forum in Indonesia.
events.why_it_matters: A new Meta app for community discussion arrives for Indonesian users.

events.event: Indonesia unveiled a domestically made 'Merah Putih' chip prototype, per CNN Indonesia.
events.key_numbers: Prototype unveiled 19 Nov 2026 · specs not verified
events.why_it_matters: Local chip ambitions amid a global chip and RAM shortage.

events.event: CNN Indonesia reported online fraud costs Indonesia Rp104.3 trillion, most often through WhatsApp.
events.key_numbers: Rp104.3 trillion losses · WhatsApp most common channel
events.why_it_matters: Scam losses are huge and WhatsApp is the main route.
